_comment: KEEP-list: npc_param_ids force-UN-pruned. Subtracted from the merged prune set (variant_prune_list.json auto + variant_prune_empirical.json) at load time, so it overrides both and survives audit regeneration. Use when the auto prune generator (dev/audit_genuine_variants.py) prunes a c-prefix's only think-LIVE variants and keeps only think-dead ones — the hard avoid-filter then drops the dead survivors and empties the pool, making an otherwise-eligible chr unplaceable. The generator's representative selection (behaviorVariationId, think//1000, has_reward, lowest id) does not consider whether the kept think id actually exists in the regulation.

c3360.reason: Ancestral Follower. These are c3360's ONLY two think-live variants (every other variant points at a think id absent from the regulation -> dead AI -> hard avoid-listed). The auto prune list pruned both as redundant duplicates, leaving only think-dead representatives, which the avoid-filter dropped -> empty pool -> c3360 silently unplaceable despite the v0.24.65 lift (the whole-MMV-roster lift, cap=1). Force-keeping these restores it to placeable with working AI so it can finally be playtested. NOTE: c3360's original v0.24.39 ban was an INVISIBLE-render report (seed 798229); the v0.24.65 lift assumed the MMV asset deploy fixed render, but that has not been per-chr playtest-confirmed for c3360. If it still renders invisible in play, exclude it via the hard target-exclude instead.
